profile.customer_focus: U.S.-only wholly owned office/distribution group with California parent
profile.geographic_register_scope: all operations within the declared corporate boundary
profile.initial_supported_period: one calendar year with stable control
profile.unsupported_input_behavior: retain in register with explicit unresolved finding; do not silently omit

scope3_taxonomy_source.use: category identification only; no method approval

required_screening_domains.scope3: exactly one group screening for each category ID 1 through 15; entity/source detail expands the register

semantic_invariants: Disposition is an assertion, not proof of resolution.
Activity data state is independent of disposition: included_activity can still have missing data.
Linked evidence does not imply sufficiency, internal acceptance, released methods, completeness or assurance.
A zero quantity is explicit activity with unit, period and basis; null remains unknown.
Excluded and not_applicable require reason and supporting references and remain visible.
Included_estimate requires estimation method version, assumptions, input provenance and uncertainty description.
Unsupported method is independent of evidence and disposition; it remains a reporting gap.
No client can write derived resolution, completeness, release eligibility, hashes or actor identity.
Every new version starts unreviewed and retains its predecessor.
No M70 or foundation version is a complete corporate inventory.
Non-California and non-US operations cannot disappear because the initial customer focus is California.
Amounts and factors are decimal strings; quantity kind, unit, gas and CO2e/GWP basis are explicit.
A total selects one Scope 2 view; alternative views cannot be added together.

serialization.encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; no insignificant whitespace
serialization.object_keys: lexically sorted after strict duplicate-key rejection
serialization.strings: validated Unicode; user labels trimmed and NFC-normalized
serialization.decimals: finite bounded decimal strings; no exponent or negative zero; insignificant fractional zeros removed
serialization.set_arrays: sort stable IDs; categories numeric ascending; intervals by start/end; reject duplicates
serialization.absent_and_null: required absent keys fail; only declared optional keys normalize to null
serialization.version_hash: profile, predecessor, content, version ID, creator and captured instant; excludes itself and later reviews
serialization.legacy_policy: do not change existing M64-M68 serialization or fixed decimal scales

mutation_contract.tenant_source: authorized route company ID; never body tenant ID
mutation_contract.actor_source: server-verified Auth subject; rechecked membership/admission inside transaction
mutation_contract.same_key_same_fingerprint: return original authorized outcome even after later head advancement
mutation_contract.same_effective_input: 422 no-op; compare full normalized input tuple
write_order: compare expected version ID and hash
insert immutable version, audit and request
mutation_contract.review_independence: reviewer must be an authorized manager absent from the target version contributor set and different from submitter
mutation_contract.correction_policy: label-only, reason-only, evidence-only and estimation-basis-only changes produce unreviewed successors

proposed_api.purpose: read current head and bounded version summaries
frozen coverage-only export; no emissions or compliance report
